scenario.name: r-cd-chained-depth-2
scenario.description: Depth-2 delegate chain: parent→child→grandchild. Nested call requests fanoutMode=tree so grandchild completion routes to root; outer parent→child is unchanged. Routing authority is the shared gateway targeted-return collector.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof chain nonce {{nonce}}: you are depth-1. Fire your own continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake', fanoutMode='tree', task='Grandchild nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} only after you arrive. Do not mutate files.'). After the nested continue_delegate tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED.

expectedReceipts.name: child-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: child-fires-grandchild
expectedReceipts.description: CHILD-DONE sentinel confirms depth-1 delegate executed the nested continue_delegate instruction

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-returns
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-bound grandchild identity and exact GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel are observed after dispatch acceptance

expectedReceipts.name: parent-receives-chain-return
expectedReceipts.description: Shared post-run collector binds exactly one in-window [continuation:targeted-return] Delivered to <root> from <grandchild> receipt with zero matching parent(child-session) receipts

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for chain visualization in Tempo

review.notes: Depth-2 chain proof. PASS-candidate requires strict child/grandchild sentinels, two distinct nonce-bound hop identities, nested fanoutMode=tree, and the shared payload-free gateway targeted-return collector proving grandchild→root routing. Transcript GRANDCHILD-DONE text is not routing authority.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live depth-2 chain row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Nested call must request fanoutMode=tree. Detector ignores prompt echoes and ordinary GRANDCHILD-DONE assistant/system transcript text; PASS requires distinct hop identities plus the shared journal targeted-return receipt.
